name: Kerberos pre-authentication AS-REQ hash extraction from PCAP
topic: Kerberos pre-authentication AS-REQ hash extraction from PCAP
description: Kerberos pre-authentication AS-REQ hash extraction from PCAP -- a medium-tier networking challenge. Review the bundled artifacts, locate the encoded clue, decode it, and recover the flag. Flag format: pwn{...}
objectives: Inspect the challenge bundle for "Kerberos pre-authentication AS-REQ hash extraction from PCAP"
Locate the encoded artifact (look in every shipped file)
Unwrap the encoding applied to the artifact
Recover the plaintext flag and submit it in pwn{...} format

hints.text: Start by inspecting every file in the bundle (hex dump, headers, magic bytes).
The artifact is wrapped in a non-text container -- use the right parser.
The artifact is base64. After decoding you have a 4-byte XOR cipher -- recover the key by crib-dragging against the known flag prefix.
